FAQ

Questions teams ask

Is this website really authored in MDL?

Yes. Every page in this example is an .mdl file, with CSS and JavaScript loaded through mdl.json.

Can I use normal CSS?

Yes. MDL emits stable classes and lets CSS own the layout, theme, responsive behavior, and polish.

Does MDL replace JavaScript?

No. It keeps JavaScript explicit. Add event attributes in MDL and export the matching handler functions.
